t: Essentials zinc-plated steel angle plates provide robust structural support for various construction and joinery projects. These durable fixings are ideal for reinforcing timber frames or securing shelving units, offering reliable strength where it is needed most. Manufactured from resilient steel with a protective zinc-plated finish, these 50mm x 13mm x 50mm angle plates ensure corrosion resistance for specialist fixing applications. Available in a convenient 10-pack, they are a practical choice for trade professionals requiring dependable hardware.
